meta.note: Cursor CLI agentic Composer 2.5 proof-completion results, converted from composer-2.5-proof-completion/results.json. The run predates the upstream split of the EWD687a spec, so it covers 473 of the 483 canonical proof-completion tasks: 14 canonical EWD687a theorems were not run and 4 pre-split EWD687a theorems were, as declared in manifest_exception. The pass rate is over the 473 tasks actually scored and is therefore not directly comparable to a full-scope bundle. 17 tasks ended before their usage telemetry flushed, so output-token and cost figures are lower bounds over the 456 tasks that carry counts.

manifest_exception.reason: Run predates the upstream split of the EWD687a spec into 16 theorems; it was graded against the earlier 6-theorem version.
